description: The `title` fixture with one word changed: `"font": "serif"`. Everything else — the string, the size, the colour, the raster — is identical, so this reference differs from that one only by the shapes of the letters. That is the whole point of it: a default nobody can select is not a choice, and without this fixture a build that ignored `font` and always set the sans face would pass every other test in the repository. Compare the two `expected/frame-0000.png` files side by side and the serifs are visible.
